hard: Live marketing copy stays verbatim (headings, subs, plan names, footnotes)
EUR prices, specs, and stock truth come from src/content/plans.json only — no invented numbers
Checkout stays in WHMCS at dash.stealthrdp.com; no checkout rebuild
No new dependencies; shadcn/Radix primitives for interactive controls
Repo gates must pass: tsc, check-design-contract.mjs, next build
soft: Keep the existing visual system (colors, type, Card/Button/Badge look)
Prefer reusing PricingExplorer state logic over rewriting data flow
Keep the full spec comparison available, just not as the primary surface

core_features: Plan choice with all specs visible and no sideways scrolling
Always-visible selection summary with total due today and Buy action

feature_surface_map.Billing-cycle choice: /plans plan-picker step 2 (compact strip, reprices everything below)
feature_surface_map.Plan choice: /plans plan-picker step 3 (stacked plan cards, specs inline, Buy Now per card)
feature_surface_map.Full spec comparison: /plans collapsed 'Compare all specs' details under the cards

later: Starter-tier plans (needs pricing data that does not exist yet)
now: Compact billing-cycle strip replacing the 5 large cards
Stacked plan cards as the primary surface (no horizontal scroll)
Sticky selection summary with total due today + Buy
Existing ledger table demoted to collapsed comparison

non_goals: No new pricing, stock, or spec data
No changes to any other page or the site visual system
product_intent: Make choosing and buying a StealthRDP VPS on /plans feel like one guided flow for a non-technical buyer: pick region, pick billing cycle, pick plan, see exactly what is due today, and buy — with every consequence of every tap visible without scrolling sideways or wondering what to do next.
success_criteria: On 390px mobile, every plan with full specs and Buy action is reachable with zero horizontal swiping
Tapping a billing cycle updates a visible total-due-today without scrolling away
Each plan card shows CPU, RAM, storage, bandwidth, total due today, and its Buy (or in-stock alternative) in one viewport block
No horizontal overflow on /plans at 390px and 1280px, verified with real browser measurements
